summary: During the same meeting, Bjorn discovers that the room has firm participation rules without anyone commanding who must speak.
settingText: Same community-center multipurpose room during the first meeting.

panelPlan.action: A silence lasts. Bjorn looks from one seated participant to the next, then fixes his eyes on the facilitator.
The facilitator answers from the same kind of chair as everyone else, leaning back with hands loose on their lap.
Bjorn leans slightly forward, brow narrowed and eyes fixed on the facilitator.
One participant drinks coffee, one looks down at folded hands, and another leans back in the chair while the silence continues.
After saying “But not orders,” Bjorn looks once around the circle and gives one slow nod. The facilitator remains seated and still.

summary: Bjorn correctly sees that another participant is not fine, but the facilitator stops him from turning that perception into permission to speak for them.
settingText: Same community-center multipurpose room, later in the first meeting.

panelPlan.action: An unnamed adult participant in ordinary contemporary clothes sits folded inward, arms close to the body, while describing an unstable housing and family situation and insisting they can manage.
Bjorn sits forward with brows drawn and answers immediately after the participant’s line.
The participant’s shoulders rise and their elbows pull inward as Bjorn says, “You fear saying so…”
The facilitator remains seated and raises one hand toward Bjorn as they say, “Stop.”
The facilitator keeps one hand raised toward Bjorn and turns the other open palm toward the participant as the exchange continues.

dialogueInline.speaker: OTHER PARTICIPANT
dialogueInline.text: It's fine. I can handle it.
You're afraid if you say it, someone decides for you.
Maybe. It's still theirs to say.

directionInline.text: The unnamed participant is an ordinary adult and remains visually separate from the recurring 1987 Participant.

summary: After the meeting, Carrie sees that Bjorn intends to return because he leaves still arguing with the facilitator instead of dismissing the room.
settingText: Community-center hallway and front sidewalk immediately after the first meeting.

panelPlan.action: Carrie waits on a bench scrolling work messages. The meeting-room door opens and participants filter out normally.
Bjorn exits while facing backward toward the facilitator inside, continuing the argument as he walks.
Carrie matches Bjorn’s stride and looks sideways at him; one corner of her mouth twitches before she asks her question.
Bjorn and Carrie keep walking. The facilitator remains in the doorway and calls after him; Bjorn answers without turning back.

dialogueInline.text: If a roof falls, you don't ask first.

summary: At home, Bjorn nearly settles an argument between the two male Kin, stops himself, and asks whether they want his decision or only his judgment.
settingText: Safe Cave, afternoon: tool storage area and lease-painted wall.

panelPlan.location: Safe Cave wall and freestanding shelf
panelPlan.action: First Male Kin holds a small wooden tool rack against the painted wall while Second Male Kin points toward the freestanding shelf instead. A drill and small hardware sit nearby.
Bjorn enters, looks from the rack against the wall to the drill in Second Male Kin’s hand, and raises one hand as his first word starts.
He stops in the middle of the first word and lowers the hand slightly.
Bjorn asks what role they actually want from him. The two men exchange a quick look before First Male Kin answers.
Bjorn looks from the landlord-painted drywall to the rack and then to the freestanding shelf before pointing at the shelf. Second Male Kin lowers the drill to the floor.

dialogueInline.text: Do you want me to decide?
No. Tell me what you think.
Then use the shelf. Don't put holes in the wall.

directionInline.text: Show exactly the two established male Kin. Astrid is absent; do not add a third Kin.

summary: On the stairs, Bjorn catches the Upstairs Neighbor before a fall without waiting to be asked, then learns that immediate safety does not give him ownership of the rest of her task.
settingText: Fifth-floor stair landing and hallway outside apartment 5B.

panelPlan.action: The Upstairs Neighbor climbs the last steps carrying a full laundry basket. One foot slips on the stair edge and the basket tips forward.
Bjorn moves instantly, catching the neighbor by the forearm with one hand and steadying the basket with the other before either person or laundry falls.
The neighbor regains her footing and takes the basket back against her hip. Bjorn reaches toward it as if to take the load.
She keeps hold of the basket and gives him a flat look while Bjorn stops reaching.
The neighbor walks toward her door under her own power. Bjorn remains by the stairs, watching her go without following.

dialogueInline.text: No. Catching me helped. I'm keeping the laundry.

summary: Bjorn overcorrects by waiting for an invitation to do ordinary shared household work, and Gunnar points out that restraint is not the same thing as becoming passive in his own home.
settingText: Safe Cave doorway, kitchenette and table during an ordinary grocery return.

panelPlan.action: Gunnar and the two male Kin enter with several grocery bags. Bjorn sits at the table, sees the load and deliberately keeps both hands where they are.
Gunnar sets two heavy bags on the floor beside Bjorn's chair and looks at him. Bjorn looks from the bags to Gunnar but does not move.
Gunnar answers while First Male Kin carries bread toward the kitchenette and Second Male Kin puts a bag on the counter.
Bjorn stands, takes the two bags from the floor and begins putting his share of the groceries away with the others.
Gunnar passes behind Bjorn with another bag and delivers the correction without stopping. Bjorn pauses, then continues unpacking.

directionInline.text: Show exactly the two established male Kin with Gunnar and Bjorn. Astrid is off-page.
